description: Seminar and research project under the direction of a faculty member. The student is required to pursue an independent project, to prepare a written report and to present a seminar describing the work.
preAndCorequisites:
• Complete all of the following
    • Minimum fourth-year standing
    • declared Honours in Computer Science or declared Combined Honours in Mathematics and Computer Science, in Physics and Computer Science, or in Statistics and Computer Science.
title: Honours Seminar and Project
